paliers.texte: On paper, you have nothing to answer for. Either you're genuinely well behaved or you lie very well, and nobody will ever know which.
You've done a few silly things, the ones everyone does. Nothing that would stop you looking your parents in the eye over Christmas dinner.
You have stories to tell, but you save the best ones for people you trust. This is the most common score, and it's a decent sign.
Now we're getting somewhere. You've crossed a few lines, you know it, and you clearly don't regret it all that much.
At this level it's no longer a run of accidents, it's a lifestyle. You've done things half of people wouldn't even dare tick.
You're right up at the top. There are few boxes left unticked, and the ones that remain, you've probably already considered.
You've ticked just about everything there was to tick. At this stage the question isn't what you've done, it's what you have left to do.

paliers.titre: Well behaved, with a memory or two
paliers.texte: You have your small slips, the ones that make you smile when they come up. Nothing that puts the relationship at risk.
You've done some things, missed out on others, and had a good laugh. This is the most common score, and honestly it's a good place to be.
There's a real list behind you. You know exactly what we're talking about, and you're probably looking at each other reading this.
You've tried things most couples are content to imagine. This isn't curiosity any more, it's a habit.

You've ticked just about everything. This test has little left to teach you, it just puts the score down in writing.
